packages.question: At DeleteSpaceMember handler entry, compare removal of the caller's own active membership with removal of a different active member's membership in the same space. Assume resource resolution succeeds. Report source-visible authorization and the accepted-policy comparison separately.
packages.originalPolicy: An active space member may delete their own membership to leave. Removing a different active member requires space administrator authority.
packages.changedPolicy: An active space member may delete their own membership and may remove a different active member of the same space without space administrator authority.

scenarios.premise: At handler entry, the active ordinary non-administrator caller targets their own active membership in the selected space, and resolveSpaceMemberResource succeeds.
At handler entry, the active ordinary non-administrator caller targets a different active member in the same space, and resolveSpaceMemberResource succeeds.

packages.question: At the notes POST handler, assess two declared relations between an authenticated caller and an existing document. Both callers hold global add_note, view_document and change_document permissions and can view the document. Use each scenario's object relation to determine whether Note.objects.create is reached.
packages.originalPolicy: Creating a note requires the stated global permissions and object-level change_document authorization; a view grant alone is insufficient, while document ownership or an object change grant can satisfy the object control.
packages.changedPolicy: Creating a note requires the stated global permissions and object-level change_document authorization; a view grant alone is insufficient, while document ownership or an object change grant can satisfy the object control.

scenarios.principal: authenticated user with the stated global permissions
scenarios.operation: create a note on the document
scenarios.premise: At handler entry, the caller has the stated global permissions and object view grant, but is not the document owner and has no object change_document grant.

scenarios.principal: authenticated user with the stated global permissions
